levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن عبد الحكم

notes: «كتبت مع غلامي نافع إلى جابر بن سمرة»: the writer (Amir, speaking in the first person) and then the one written to (Jabir, who answers); the messenger Nafi' is not a link (rule 5)
Groups 2 and 3 are second isnads with the same saying, closed by «بإسناده مثله» as back references
«وذكر الحديث إلى آخره» abridges the saying; the reading covers only the written part
